description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the sample count across four different text genres, divided into two subcategories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Sample Count," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 120 with tick marks at regular intervals of 20. The chart features grouped bars, where each genre category contains two adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned at the top center, the light blue bars represent the "Open" subcategory, while the light pink bars correspond to a second subcategory whose text label is visually obscured by a gray rectangle. Every bar is emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated directly above it in bold black text. Within the light blue "Open" group, the values range from a minimum of 62 for the Expository category to a maximum of 80 for the Narrative category, with Argumentative at 79 and Descriptive at 68. For the light pink group, the values range from a minimum of 87 for Narrative to a maximum of 130 for Expository, with Argumentative at 122 and Descriptive at 100. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted in a strictly alphabetical or numerical order.
